releaseNotes: Fresh start: previous servers, chats, messages and chat media were removed while accounts and remembered sessions were preserved.
The Android keyboard now resizes chats correctly so the composer remains visible while typing.
Saved Messages is pinned first, and messages now support reply, forward and emoji reactions without duplicate sends.
Profiles now support a bio, status, editable name, avatar and up to ten ordered profile photos.
Chat headers show live online or last-seen state and open the person's profile when tapped.
Voice notes and attachments use native streamed uploads, fixing the ArrayBuffer Blob crash on older Android devices.
Navigation shapes, server icons and screen transitions are now consistent and more fluid.
